caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden armchair positioned at an angle, showing both the front and the right side. The chair has a high backrest, with a rectangular frame, and features carved decorative elements at the top, including scalloped edging and circular motifs. The backrest contains a central panel with an arch design and wood grain detailing in shades of brown and reddish-brown. The arms of the chair are thick and gently curve outward, with turned supports connecting the armrests to the seat and legs. The seat itself is flat and has subtle woodgrain shading, matching the warm brown hues used throughout the chair. The front legs are also turned and joined by horizontal and vertical stretchers along the sides and front for structural support. The drawing is rendered in colored pencil or watercolor with careful attention to shading, emphasizing the various tones of brown found in the wood. The background is plain with a faint double-line border enclosing the image.
title: Chair
